text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah takes 1st! It's Air Messiah! 
Living up to the title of "Queen of the 
Oaks," Air Messiah delivers a truly 
commanding run!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I did it... I did it!! I was able to 
dedicate the "Queen's" crown to my 
mother...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(We did it, both of us!! Everything I 
built up with Trainer has truly 
blossomed—!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Right... That's right. I wasn't... 
mistaken... right...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Cesario-san—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations. Truly, a magnificent 
run. I pursued you with all my might... 
but to think you'd dodge past me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating. ...Yeah, to be honest— 
my chest feels like it's burning black 
from the inside out. With jealousy, 
envy... or perhaps anger at myself.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It is undeniably painful. But I shall not 
extinguish it. ...If only to ensure these 
flames become my strength.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san. Bearing the defeat you dealt 
me close to my heart —I shall move forward 
to the next stage.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (I had... no words to reply with.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(In silence, just... her gaze. I was 
completely captivated by its sharpness.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I can't help but realize it. Those eyes 
of Cesario's. That's—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Those were the eyes of someone undergoing 
an evolution.)

And some time after the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks)...

At a press conference suddenly held for 
Cesario, a shocking announcement was made.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Wh...?! C-Cesario is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: To the American Oaks...！？

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, an invitation from 
America...! So you're heading there to 
become the 'Queen' of that country as 
well, are you!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I plan to make preparations 
immediately and travel to America.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“And without fail— I will grasp the first 
glory for a Japanese Umamusume in these 
hands.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that I too may serve as a cornerstone, 
joining the long, unbroken history of the 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I swear right here and now that I will 
show you a performance overwhelmingly more 
evolved than the one at the Japanese Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooohh...!!

I turn off the TV as the press conference 
ends. Instantly, a painful silence settles 
over the room... as if recounting the 
tremendous energy of the conference just 
moments ago.

Cesario's words carried immense strength. 
They were filled with absolute conviction. 
And that was precisely why—a sudden chill 
ran down my spine.
choice_data_list: (How much will she grow... by autumn...?!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the final leg of the 
Triple Tiara... The Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just as I told you at the beginning... 
this is a race that I simply cannot afford 
to lose.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Especially the Shuka Sho. That race where 
Mother was the G1 favorite for the first 
time in her career... and suffered defeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As their daughter, I will win. And I will 
prove it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To prove that Mother was never just 
'close'! To show the sacred strength of 
the bloodline passed down to me!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: With these legs of mine—without fail!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I cannot drop this race. ...I refuse to 
lose. No matter what, the Shuka Sho is one 
I must—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That's why... the data—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us revise Cesario-san's data. Her 
projected growth results... must be 
estimated significantly higher.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And then... please let me restructure our 
plans. Regarding our upcoming training, 
including the summer training camp menu."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Based on the data... we should reconsider.

The usual policy. The usual approach. Air 
Messiah's proposal itself was no different 
from ordinary.

However, her voice was unmistakable— it 
was remarkably faint.

Course correction. Re-examination. 
Re-examination. ...That day's meeting 
ended up taking an unimaginably long time.
